desc: Prepared Florida patio footprint with compacted crushed-stone base, straight black edge restraint, an even bedding-sand section, string line, level, and plain pavers staged at the perimeter.
reuse_notes: Use for paver-patio base preparation, edge restraint, bedding-sand layout, hardscape planning, and drainage-conscious exterior projects. It depicts a generic preparation stage, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for confirming excavation depth, base compaction, slope, utilities, material compatibility, or permit requirements.
